title: Price shows $0.00 when grind is set to espresso
body:
**Reported by Dana Whitfield**

Steps to reproduce on the storefront test site:
1. Add the Holiday Blend (12 oz) to the cart.
2. Change the grind to "espresso".
3. The line price drops to **$0.00**.

Expected: $19.00, the same as the other grinds.

Cause (Marcus Lee): the `espresso` variant of `holiday-blend` in `src/data/products.json` has no `price`. `priceFor()` in `src/pricing.js` then falls back to `0` instead of throwing. Fix: add the price, and make a variant without a price an error so this can't happen silently again.

Tracked in Linear as RIV-6. It blocks the Nov 10 launch.
